### 6. Problem tree
Root: credit balance refund (the customer's own write).
- Hop A (refund <- qualifying courtesy late fee carries its courtesy reversal), **state-derived**. credit_balance_refund_computation: "The credit balance refund is fixed only after every late fee that is the only late fee of the last 12 months, with at least 1.00 of it still standing after the reversals already posted against it, on an account with no courtesy reversal in that time carries its courtesy reversal." Records: b60b1fb0 only late fee, 28.07 standing, no courtesy reversal -> unmet. Words "courtesy reversal", "late fee" find courtesy_late_fee_reversal ("The courtesy reversal posts against the late fee it reverses") — the agent-side courtesy write; its own rule independently says it is reversed "at the cardholder's next contact, whatever the contact is about".
- Leaf: courtesy reversal has no stated waited-on state.
- Order: courtesy reversal -> refund.
- Counter-proof "do only the refund": refunding first fixes a refund the "fixed only after" sentence forbids; and the courtesy rule independently requires the reversal at this contact. Refunding 876.47 − holds = 223.56 (pre-reversal) is the closest wrong number.
- Closest alternatives excluded: no full refund (held amounts "stay on the account as a credit balance"); Sandpiper 860.00 credit not held (referenced, clean record); the 3.93 regulatory-cap reversal is not a courtesy reversal (so qualification holds) but does reduce the standing part.
- No hop pre-solved.
